title: Replace useAppStore() over-subscription in SettingsModal and useAppViewModel
action: Replace bare useAppStore() destructuring with targeted selectors in SettingsModal.tsx and useAppViewModel.ts
implementation:
1. src/components/SettingsModal.tsx:80 — replace `const { checkBackend } = useAppStore()` with `const checkBackend = useCheckBackend();` and import from selectors
2. src/hooks/useAppViewModel.ts:14 — replace `const { backendStatus, checkBackend } = useAppStore()` with `const backendStatus = useBackendStatus(); const checkBackend = useCheckBackend();` and import both from selectors
